senses.en: the act of damaging someone's reputation by unfair criticism

example.en: He spoke of his rival without detraction.
example.zh: 他谈论对手时没有诋毁。

senses.en: a place where a battle is or was fought

example.en: The old farmhouse still stands on the battlefield.
example.zh: 那座旧农舍仍然矗立在战场上。

senses.en: a district whose voters elect a representative

example.en: She was elected to Parliament by her constituency.
example.zh: 她由所在选区选入议会。

senses.en: all the voters in such a district

example.en: The senator tries to satisfy every constituency.
example.zh: 这位参议员努力让所有选民都满意。

senses.en: a man who is from France or has French nationality

example.en: He married a Frenchman and moved to Paris.
example.zh: 他嫁给了一位法国人，搬到了巴黎。

senses.en: on the inside or closer to the center

example.en: The inner door leads to a small courtyard.
example.zh: 里面的门通向一个小庭院。

senses.en: existing in the mind or feelings

example.en: He stayed calm by focusing on his inner strength.
example.zh: 他专注于内心的力量，保持镇定。

senses.en: very great in degree or intensity

example.en: The desert is known for extreme heat in summer.
example.zh: 这片沙漠以夏季的极端高温而闻名。

senses.en: very strong and unusual, especially in beliefs or actions

example.en: The committee rejected the most extreme proposals.
example.zh: 委员会否决了最偏激的提案。

senses.en: a very high degree or either of two opposite ends

example.en: She avoids extremes in diet and exercise.
example.zh: 她在饮食和锻炼上都避免走极端。

senses.en: to walk around slowly without a clear direction or purpose

example.en: We wandered around the old town for hours.
example.zh: 我们在老城里逛了好几个小时。

senses.en: to stop concentrating and start thinking about other things

example.en: My mind began to wander during the long lecture.
example.zh: 在漫长的讲座中，我开始走神了。

senses.en: to follow a curving route

example.en: The narrow path wanders along the hillside.
example.zh: 这条狭窄的小路沿着山坡蜿蜒。

senses.en: the quality of being morally good and doing what is right

example.en: Honesty is a virtue that earns trust.
example.zh: 诚实是一种赢得信任的美德。

senses.en: a good or useful quality of something

example.en: The plan's main virtue is its simplicity.
example.zh: 这个计划的主要优点是简单。

senses.en: an informal word for a man or person

example.en: He’s a nice guy who always helps his neighbors.
example.zh: 他是个总是帮助邻居的好人。

senses.en: a rope or cable used to steady a structure

example.en: Workers tighten the guy wires to stabilize the tower.
example.zh: 工人们拉紧拉索以稳定塔架。

senses.en: to steady or support something with a guy wire

example.en: They guyed the antenna to keep it upright in strong winds.
example.zh: 他们用拉索固定天线，使其在强风中保持直立。

senses.en: belonging to the present time; modern

example.en: The museum focuses on contemporary art.
example.zh: 这家博物馆专注于当代艺术。

senses.en: belonging to the same period as another person or thing

example.en: The two poets were contemporary with each other.
example.zh: 这两位诗人是同时代的人。

senses.en: a person who lives at the same time as another, especially one of similar age
senses.zh: 同时代的人；（年龄相仿的）同辈

example.en: She interviewed several of the artist's contemporaries.
example.zh: 她采访了这位艺术家的几位同时代人。

senses.en: able to be changed or set to different positions or amounts

example.en: The chair has an adjustable backrest.
example.zh: 这把椅子的靠背是可调节的。

senses.en: to change from a gas into a liquid

example.en: Steam condenses on the cold window.
example.zh: 蒸汽在冰冷的窗户上凝结。

senses.en: to make a text or speech shorter and clearer

example.en: She condensed her report into two pages.
example.zh: 她把报告压缩成两页。

senses.en: to become worse in quality, condition, or character

example.en: The discussion degenerated into an argument.
example.zh: 讨论演变成了一场争吵。

senses.en: having become worse than normal; showing a decline from a better state

example.en: The old bridge is in a degenerate state.
example.zh: 这座旧桥的状况已经很糟糕了。

senses.en: a person considered to have low moral standards, especially involving sex (disapproving)
senses.zh: 堕落者；（尤指性行为方面）道德败坏的人（贬义）

example.en: The tabloids portrayed him as a degenerate.
example.zh: 小报把他描绘成一个道德败坏的人。

senses.en: wild animals and plants living in their natural environment

example.en: The national park is home to a wide variety of wildlife.
example.zh: 这个国家公园是众多野生动植物的家园。

senses.en: a smoothbore gun that fires cartridges of small pellets, used for hunting birds or in sport

example.en: The hunter cleaned his shotgun after the trip.
example.zh: 猎人狩猎回来后清洁了他的猎枪。

senses.en: (informal, chiefly US) the front passenger seat in a car
senses.zh: （口语，主要美式）汽车副驾驶座

example.en: The kids raced to call shotgun in the car.
example.zh: 孩子们争着抢先坐汽车副驾驶座。

senses.en: a powerful tropical storm with strong winds and heavy rain, occurring in the western Pacific region

example.en: The typhoon hit the coast last night.
example.zh: 台风昨晚袭击了海岸。

senses.en: the passing of hours, days, and years, measured in hours, minutes, etc.

example.en: We don't have much time before the train leaves.
example.zh: 火车开之前我们的时间不多了。

senses.en: an occasion when something happens; a moment

example.en: This is the first time I have visited Beijing.
example.zh: 这是我第一次来北京。

senses.en: to measure how long something takes

example.en: He timed the runner with a stopwatch.
example.zh: 他用秒表给跑步者计时。

senses.en: to choose or arrange when something will happen

example.en: They timed the launch for early morning.
example.zh: 他们把发射安排在清晨。

senses.en: able to be defended or justified

example.en: Her position is defensible with solid evidence.
example.zh: 她的立场有确凿的证据支持，是站得住脚的。

senses.en: continuing at full strength without becoming weaker

example.en: The storm raged unabated all night.
example.zh: 暴风雨整夜肆虐，丝毫没有减弱。

senses.en: stuck on the bottom in shallow water, said of a ship

example.en: The tanker ran aground near the coast.
example.zh: 油轮在近海搁浅了。

senses.en: onto or on the ground underwater so a ship cannot float

example.en: The ship went aground during the storm.
example.zh: 船在暴风雨中搁浅了。

senses.en: a thick rough woolen fabric used for clothing

example.en: He wore a tweed jacket to the office.
example.zh: 他穿着粗花呢夹克去办公室。

senses.en: to be a perfect example or typical representation of something

example.en: Her career epitomises hard work and talent.
example.zh: 她的职业生涯体现了勤奋和才华。

senses.en: to look at and understand written words

example.en: She reads the news every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早上读新闻。

senses.en: to say written words aloud

example.en: He read the poem to the class.
example.zh: 他把这首诗念给全班听。

senses.en: to understand or interpret something in a particular way

example.en: She read his silence as agreement.
example.zh: 她把他的沉默理解为同意。

senses.en: a book or piece of writing that is enjoyable to read
senses.zh: 读物；读起来有趣的作品

example.en: The novel is a gripping read.
example.zh: 这部小说读起来引人入胜。

senses.en: an animal with a hard shell and two claws that usually lives in or near water

example.en: We caught a crab on the beach.
example.zh: 我们在海滩上抓到一只螃蟹。

senses.en: to complain in an annoyed way

example.en: He kept crabbing about the weather.
example.zh: 他不停地抱怨天气。

senses.en: an informal word for a bad-tempered person
senses.zh: 脾气坏的人；爱抱怨的人

example.en: Don't be such a crab.
example.zh: 别这么脾气坏。

senses.en: to make something less tight or firmly fixed

example.en: He loosened his tie after work.
example.zh: 下班后他松开了领带。

senses.en: to become less tight or stiff

example.en: The old bolts have loosened over time.
example.zh: 旧螺栓随着时间推移变松了。

senses.en: to make rules or controls less strict

example.en: The government loosened restrictions on trade.
example.zh: 政府放宽了贸易限制。

senses.en: feeling afraid or worried

example.en: She gave a fearful glance at the dark hallway.
example.zh: 她害怕地朝黑暗的走廊瞥了一眼。

senses.en: very frightening or terrible

example.en: The storm caused fearful damage along the coast.
example.zh: 风暴在沿海地区造成了可怕的破坏。

senses.en: everything around a place or person; the environment

example.en: The house is beautiful, but the surroundings are noisy.
example.zh: 这房子很漂亮，但周围环境很吵。

senses.en: to officially give out money, time or resources for a particular purpose

example.en: The government allocated more funds to public education this year.
example.zh: 政府今年向公共教育拨出了更多资金。

senses.en: an organized list of names, addresses, or contact details

example.en: You can find her phone number in the staff directory.
example.zh: 你可以在员工名录里查到她的电话号码。

senses.en: a folder on a computer for storing files

example.en: Save the document in the project directory.
example.zh: 把文档保存在项目目录里。

senses.en: in a way that cannot be avoided; certainly or unavoidably

example.en: Prices will inevitably rise when demand increases.
example.zh: 当需求增加时，价格不可避免地会上涨。

senses.en: to rise quickly to a high level or height

example.en: House prices soared last year.
example.zh: 去年房价大幅上涨。

senses.en: to fly high in the air without much effort, using air currents

example.en: Eagles soared above the mountains.
example.zh: 鹰在群山上空翱翔。

senses.en: goods carried by a ship, plane, truck, or other vehicle

example.en: The ship was carrying a cargo of grain.
example.zh: 这艘船装载着一批谷物货物。

senses.en: a yellow alloy of copper and zinc

example.en: The door handle is made of brass.
example.zh: 门把手是黄铜做的。

senses.en: brass musical instruments, or the section of a band that plays them

example.en: She plays trumpet in the school brass band.
example.zh: 她在学校铜管乐队里吹小号。

senses.en: (informal, British) extreme self-confidence or boldness

example.en: He had the brass to ask for a raise on his first day.
example.zh: 他上班第一天就有胆量要求加薪。

collocations: have the brass to do something

senses.en: useful and easy for you; causing no difficulty

example.en: The hotel is convenient to the train station.
example.zh: 这家酒店离火车站很近，很方便。

senses.en: able to explode, or relating to explosion

example.en: The firefighters removed the explosive device from the building.
example.zh: 消防员从大楼里移除了爆炸装置。

senses.en: likely to cause sudden strong emotion or violence

example.en: The situation in the region remains explosive.
example.zh: 该地区的局势仍然一触即发。

senses.en: involving sudden great force or energy

example.en: She is known for her explosive speed on the track.
example.zh: 她以在跑道上的爆发性速度而闻名。

senses.en: a substance that can explode

example.en: The workers handled the explosives with great care.
example.zh: 工人们非常小心地处理炸药。

senses.en: relating to a parliament

example.en: The bill was debated in a parliamentary committee.
example.zh: 该法案在议会委员会中进行了讨论。

senses.en: having a system of government in which the executive is drawn from and answerable to the parliament

example.en: The United Kingdom has a parliamentary system of government.
example.zh: 英国实行议会制政体。

senses.en: a painful or difficult experience that tests someone
senses.zh: 严酷的考验；痛苦的折磨

example.en: Being trapped in the elevator was a terrible ordeal.
example.zh: 被困在电梯里是一场可怕的煎熬。

senses.en: showing feelings or ideas clearly
senses.zh: 富于表现力的；表情丰富的

example.en: She has very expressive eyes.
example.zh: 她的眼睛非常传神。

senses.en: a large extinct elephant with long curved tusks and hairy coat

example.en: Scientists found the remains of a woolly mammoth in the ice.
example.zh: 科学家在冰层中发现了猛犸象的遗骸。

senses.en: extremely large

example.en: They faced a mammoth task cleaning up after the storm.
example.zh: 风暴过后，他们面临着一项艰巨的清理任务。

senses.en: a river or stream that flows into a larger river

example.en: The Ohio River is a major tributary of the Mississippi.
example.zh: 俄亥俄河是密西西比河的一条主要支流。

senses.en: flowing into a larger river or stream

example.en: This tributary stream joins the main river near the village.
example.zh: 这条支流在村庄附近汇入干流。

senses.en: impressive, grand, and dignified in appearance
senses.zh: 庄严的，宏伟的，气派十足的

example.en: A stately mansion stood at the top of the hill.
example.zh: 山顶矗立着一座气派宏伟的宅邸。

senses.en: a member of an academy, especially an honorary member of an institution of arts or sciences

example.en: She was elected an academician of the Royal Academy.
example.zh: 她当选为皇家艺术研究院院士。

senses.en: a scholar or academic

example.en: The conference attracted many leading academicians.
example.zh: 这次会议吸引了许多著名学者。

senses.en: a farm tool with blades that breaks up and smooths soil

example.en: The farmer pulled the harrow behind his tractor to prepare the field.
example.zh: 农民用拖拉机牵引着耙来平整田地。

senses.en: to break up or level soil with a harrow

example.en: They harrowed the field before planting the seeds.
example.zh: 播种前他们先把地耙平。

senses.en: to distress or torment someone greatly

example.en: The news harrowed everyone in the community.
example.zh: 这个消息让社区里的每个人都极为痛苦。

senses.en: to be a sign or indication of something

example.en: Her confident manner bespoke years of experience.
example.zh: 她自信的举止显示出多年的经验。

senses.en: to order or reserve something in advance (formal, chiefly British)

example.en: They bespoke a handmade suit from the tailor.
example.zh: 他们向裁缝预订了一套手工西装。

senses.en: a stone or concrete platform beside water where ships load and unload

example.en: Fishing boats were tied up along the quay.
example.zh: 渔船停泊在码头边。

senses.en: causing or expressing strong emotion

example.en: The film deals with highly emotive themes like loss and forgiveness.
example.zh: 这部电影涉及失去与宽恕等极易触动情感的主题。

senses.en: to warn someone about something in advance

example.en: The report forewarned investors of possible risks.
example.zh: 这份报告预先提醒投资者注意潜在风险。

senses.en: a formal speech, especially on an important occasion

example.en: The senator delivered an eloquent oration at the ceremony.
example.zh: 参议员在典礼上发表了一篇雄辩的演说。

senses.en: a person who believes nothing can be known about whether God exists

example.en: As an agnostic, she neither affirmed nor denied God's existence.
example.zh: 作为不可知论者，她既不肯定也不否定上帝的存在。

senses.en: relating to agnosticism; uncertain about claims to knowledge
senses.zh: 不可知论的；（对某事）持怀疑态度的

example.en: He remained agnostic about the outcome of the negotiations.
example.zh: 他对谈判结果持不可知的态度。

senses.en: a person who stirs up trouble or strong political feeling

example.en: The young firebrand stirred up protests in the city.
example.zh: 这位年轻的煽动者在城里掀起抗议活动。

senses.en: a piece of burning wood

example.en: Sparks flew from the burning firebrand.
example.zh: 火星从燃烧的木柴上飞溅出来。

senses.en: a pot with a spout and handle used for making and pouring tea

example.en: She poured hot tea from the teapot into my cup.
example.zh: 她把热茶从茶壶倒进我的杯子里。

senses.en: not moving or lacking the ability to move

example.en: He lay inert on the sofa, too tired to move.
example.zh: 他一动不动地躺在沙发上，累得动不了。

senses.en: chemically inactive; not reacting with other substances

example.en: Nitrogen is an inert gas at room temperature.
example.zh: 氮气在室温下是一种惰性气体。

senses.en: relating to harmony in music

example.en: The piece has rich harmonic texture.
example.zh: 这首乐曲有丰富的和声织体。

senses.en: a tone whose frequency is a whole-number multiple of a fundamental frequency

example.en: The guitarist played a clear harmonic on the twelfth fret.
example.zh: 吉他手在第十二品弹出了一个清晰的泛音。

senses.en: the process of making something active, successful, or lively again

example.en: The revitalization of the old town attracted many tourists.
example.zh: 老城区的振兴吸引了众多游客。

senses.en: to force liquid out in a thin fast stream

example.en: She squirted lemon juice over the fish.
example.zh: 她往鱼上挤了柠檬汁。

senses.en: a small burst of liquid

example.en: A squirt of oil is enough for the pan.
example.zh: 喷一小股油就够了。

senses.en: a person who lives alone, away from other people

example.en: The old hermit lived in a cabin deep in the forest.
example.zh: 那位老隐士住在森林深处的一间小屋里。

senses.en: relating to immediate basic medical help given to an injured person

example.en: Every office should have a first-aid kit on site.
example.zh: 每个办公室都应配备急救箱。
